name: nba-scores-mod
description: Today's NBA scoreboard above the Claude Code prompt. Pick your team and it gets its own totem and team color; scores update live while games are on. Live data from ESPN's public endpoints, no key and no account. Zero model tokens.

team.title: Your team
team.description: Your team is listed first and gets its own totem and team color.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the text on the band. Auto shows Traditional Chinese when your computer is on Taiwan time, English everywhere else. 帶子上文字的語言。

spoilerFree.title: Spoiler-free
spoilerFree.description: Hide the score of finished games until you click Reveal. 遮住已結束比賽的比分，點了才顯示。
